objective: 用宽大的圆角矩形面板替换尺寸不足的圆形表情窗口，用清晰的关节组件与带方向的连杆整流罩替换管状机械臂几何，并将视觉颈部改为可制造的挂载式头部接口，同时保留躯干侧肩部与七轴 Revision D 架构。
acceptance: the expression display is a landscape rounded rectangle that occupies most of the existing head front
each arm remains seven-axis with a recessed three-axis shoulder, readable elbow cartridge, roll cuff, and compact two-axis wrist
upper-arm and forearm fairings are directional rounded housings rather than undifferentiated cylinders
the SCAD, STEP, engineering drawing, interactive render, and campaign image use the same face and arm design language
the head is supported by a keyed neck pedestal, shoulder flange, hidden M6 fasteners, dowel pins, and a central cable passage
the torso-side shoulder architecture remains unchanged
mechanical tests, Ruff, and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: 该优化需要改动 `robot/control`、`firmware`、`interfaces` 或 PCB 的归属
显示面板无法在现有头部包络内保留结构性边框
机械臂造型会遮挡轴线中心，或与声明的七轴拓扑相矛盾
视觉效果会暗示不存在的物理原型或验证结果
